name: qa-catalog
description: End-to-end QA testing as a Claude Code plugin. Auto-discovers your stack and routes, drives every page in a real browser via the bundled Playwright MCP, runs the whole platform in parallel test-runner subagents, verifies each result against a schema, and files defects to GitHub/Jira/Azure DevOps if connected. No test code to write — the plugin understands your app from source.

dev_url.title: Dev server URL
dev_url.description: Base URL where the app under test is running (e.g. http://localhost:3000). Used by every browser-driving subagent. Leave blank to auto-detect from the framework manifest at scan time.

parallel_agents.title: Parallel page-analyzer agents
parallel_agents.description: Maximum number of page-analyzer subagents the orchestrator runs concurrently during /qa-catalog:init and /qa-catalog:scan. Each agent uses its own isolated Playwright browser context. Set to 1 to serialize. Recommended: 2-4 on a laptop, 4-8 on a workstation.

parallel_test_authors.title: Parallel test-author agents
parallel_test_authors.description: Maximum concurrent test-author subagents (pure markdown generation, no browser). Safe to keep high.

parallel_test_runners.title: Parallel test-runner agents
parallel_test_runners.description: Maximum concurrent test-runner subagents the orchestrator runs during /qa-catalog:run-all. Each runner drives its own isolated Playwright browser context against the shared MCP server. Set to 1 to serialize a full-platform regression. Recommended: 2-4 on a laptop, 4-8 on a workstation. The shared dev server is the practical ceiling.

browser_engine.title: Browser engine
browser_engine.description: Which browser-automation MCP the project-level qa-page-analyzer / qa-test-runner agents drive: playwright (default, full screenshot/console/network fidelity, all browsers), chrome-devtools (Chrome-only, DevTools-grade performance + network insight), or stagehand (Browserbase cloud browser, AI-driven act/observe/extract — experimental). /qa-catalog:init writes the matching mcpServers block into .claude/agents/. See docs/browsers/.

browser_channel.title: Browser channel
browser_channel.description: For the playwright / chrome-devtools engines, which browser to launch: chromium (default), chrome, msedge, firefox, webkit. Ignored by the stagehand (cloud) engine.

browser_headless.title: Run browser headless
browser_headless.description: Run the Playwright browser without a visible window. Set false to watch agents interact with the app while they analyze.

settle_ms.title: Per-page settle time (ms)
settle_ms.description: Milliseconds the page-analyzer waits after navigation before snapshotting. Increase for slow SPAs.

auth_mode.title: Auth mode
auth_mode.description: How protected routes are authenticated: none, shared-credentials (use the single username/password below for every protected route), storage-state (reuse a Playwright storageState JSON from auth_storage_state_path), per-role (look up the task's required role in the gitignored QA-tests/.qa-catalog/auth.local.json credential map — supports a different login per role).

auth_username.title: Default auth username
auth_username.description: Username used when auth_mode is shared-credentials.

auth_password.title: Default auth password
auth_password.description: Password used when auth_mode is shared-credentials. Stored in the OS keychain.

auth_storage_state_path.title: Playwright storageState file
auth_storage_state_path.description: Path to a Playwright storageState JSON file (cookies + localStorage). Used when auth_mode is storage-state.

auth_credentials_file.title: Per-role credential map
auth_credentials_file.description: Path to the per-role credential map used when auth_mode is per-role. Defaults to QA-tests/.qa-catalog/auth.local.json (scaffolded by /qa-catalog:init). This file is gitignored; it holds non-secret usernames + storageState paths and references passwords via ${ENV_VAR} so no plaintext secret is ever written to disk. Resolved by scripts/auth-resolve.mjs.

default_role.title: Default user role
default_role.description: Role to assume when a route doesn't specify one. Tasks reference this in Preconditions.

available_roles.title: Available roles
available_roles.description: Roles the app supports (e.g. admin, manager, user, guest). The route-discoverer cross-references these against route guards.

task_depth.title: Task depth
task_depth.description: deep (default): exhaustive validation matrix + modal + button coverage. standard: happy path + key edge cases. smoke: title + first form only. Affects the test-author's enforced template.

max_tasks_per_route.title: Max tasks per route
max_tasks_per_route.description: Upper bound the test-author enforces. Default 6.

exclude_globs.title: Excluded source globs
exclude_globs.description: Globs to skip during route discovery (e.g. **/storybook/**, **/__tests__/**).
